lines.text: God gave Jesus Christ the revelation, and He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John.
John writes to the seven churches in the province of Asia, with grace and peace from Jesus Christ, the firstborn from the dead.
John was on the island of Cyprus when a loud voice like a trumpet told him to write on a scroll.
John saw seven golden lampstands, and among them One like the Son of Man, who held seven stars in His left hand.
John fell at His feet like a dead man, and the Living One said He holds the keys of Death and of Hades.
